items.t: Tsawwassen townhomes cluster in Southlands (Market Avenue), at Eden Crescent and 10A Avenue, and at 52 Street and 7A Avenue.
Southlands townhomes sit in southeast Tsawwassen, near Boundary Bay Road; the sales centre is at 101–6388 Market Avenue.
Centennial Green, in Southlands, is 16 freehold strata townhomes around a shared green: three-bedroom homes of 1,378–1,835 square feet.
Bayside Mews, also in Southlands, is 13 townhomes on a tree-lined mews: three-bedroom-and-den homes of 1,636–1,679 square feet.
Southlands townhomes are freehold strata, while its rowhomes are non-strata, per Century Group's FAQ.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: New townhome sites need rezoning to Townhouse Residential 76 (RT76): Eden Crescent rezones four lots from Single Detached Residential 1 (RS1) to RT76.
Stacked townhomes at 52 Street and 7A Avenue need a new Comprehensive Development Zone instead, consolidating two lots into one.

items.t: Beach Grove Park, 6051 17A Avenue, serving Beach Grove townhome streets, lists off-leash areas, tennis courts and trails.
Late French Immersion for South Delta is at Cliff Drive Elementary from Grade 6, serving Ladner and Tsawwassen.
Winskill Aquatic and Fitness Centre is being replaced (started summer 2025) with a ten-lane, 25-metre lap pool.
Diefenbaker Park, 5579 1 Avenue, a former gravel operation, lists a viewpoint, trails and water park.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: Eden Crescent Townhouses, 1059 and 1069 Eden Crescent, applicant BURO47 Architecture: 27 three-bedroom townhomes. STATUS: not yet to Council, meeting June 25, 2026; read 2026-11-03.
Dennison Gate, 52 Street and 7A Avenue, applicant not stated: 50 stacked townhomes, one to four bedrooms. STATUS: rezoning application, meeting December 4, 2025; read 2026-11-03.
Tsawwassen Springs Townhouses, 4800 and 5133 Springs Boulevard, applicant Tsawwassen Golf and Country Club Ltd.: 60 townhomes. STATUS: third reading December 4, 2023; read 2026-11-03.
Selected route 601 trips start in Boundary Bay, serving Southlands, via 1A Avenue, 66A Street, 3 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road and 56 Street, per TransLink.
Bus route 620 runs from Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) to the Tsawwassen ferry terminal, per BC Ferries' transit directions.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check flood protection on DeltaMap for a Beach Grove townhome: it carries flood protection, dike elevations and permit areas by parcel.
Oceanfront rules can affect Beach Grove complexes: the City lists the Fisheries Act, Riparian Areas Regulation and flood requirements as possibly applying.

faq.a: They are freehold strata, so a monthly strata fee applies. Century Group's FAQ states Southlands townhomes and condo flats are freehold strata homes, with fees covering common-area maintenance, landscaping and snow removal, while its rowhomes, duplexes and estate cottages offer non-strata ownership instead.
faq.q: Are Southlands townhomes strata or non-strata?

faq.a: Less than buyers may expect at Eden Crescent, where the proposal varies visitor parking down to zero. The City's application page lists 27 three-bedroom townhomes with 42 garage spaces, nine new on-street spaces on Eden Crescent and 10A Avenue, and a variance reducing on-site visitor spaces from three to none.
faq.q: How much visitor parking do new townhome projects provide?

faq.a: A stacked townhome is a unit stacked above or below another, rather than side by side. The Dennison Gate proposal at 52 Street and 7A Avenue lists 50 stacked units of one to four bedrooms in seven three-storey buildings, at a floor space ratio of 0.6.
faq.q: What is a stacked townhome at Dennison Gate?

faq.a: South Delta Secondary is the public secondary school for Tsawwassen addresses, including the 52 Street and 7A Avenue area. Delta School District No. 37 publishes Tsawwassen catchment maps, notes boundaries are reviewed and occasionally adjusted, and directs families to verify the exact address in its School Locator.
